name: Cheval Gloucester Park
tagline: A Kensington residence of 98 fully equipped apartments, bookable for any length of stay.
description:
Situated in London’s Kensington district, Cheval Gloucester Park is a luxury Residence with 98 beautifully appointed and fully equipped apartments, available to book for any length of stay.

The apartments are superbly located just two minutes’ walk from Gloucester Road Underground Station and there is secure underground parking available. Cheval Gloucester Park features a combination of 1-, 2- and 3-bedroom apartments plus three stunning 5-bedroom penthouses on the upper floors, as well as an on-site gym and private cinema room for up to 12.

Choosing to stay in an apartment at Cheval Gloucester Park during your visit to London means you’ll have all the extra space you deserve along with all the services you would expect at home, complemented by our 24-hour front office team who can assist with restaurant reservations, theatre bookings, transport and more.

Welcome to Cheval Gloucester Park, a luxury all-apartment Residence in Kensington, London available to book for any length of stay, from one night to one year or more. Cheval Gloucester Park’s 98 beautifully appointed and fully-equipped apartments are ideal for leisure and business, and are suitable for families as well as travellers in London looking for a base while they work.

## About the residence

The Cheval story began in the vibrant streets of Knightsbridge, to the west of central London and only a 20 minute walk from Cheval Gloucester Park. As an organisation we acquired our first property in 1981 in Cheval Place, a quiet street in the heart of Knightsbridge set back from the bustling Brompton Road, and home to some of London’s most iconic shopping destinations. This was to form the heart of our Cheval Knightsbridge Residence.

Knightsbridge itself is named after an ancient bridge spanning the Westbourne Stream, and as the first half of the word implies, was the gathering point of knights and their retainers. These knights would have required somewhere to stable their horses, suggesting that Cheval Place, from the French for horse, was aptly named.

Cheval Gloucester Park joined the Cheval Residences portfolio in 1991 and was purpose-built with a total of 100 units, primarily 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments. There was also a single 4-bedroom penthouse on the 10th floor. After 27 successful years of operation, and after feedback from our guests, the decision was taken to close Cheval Gloucester Park for a period of almost two years to undergo a full-scale refurbishment. Although the building’s primary structure was to remain unchanged, virtually everything else was renewed, from the air-conditioning to the wiring to the floors.

The renewed Cheval Gloucester Park relaunched in February 2020 and features three 5-bedroom penthouses on the 8th, 9th and 10th floors, in addition to 95 other apartments which have been refurbished to the highest standard.

## Apartment types

The choice of apartments at Cheval Gloucester Park is extensive, ranging from one-bedroom apartments comfortably sleeping two, to family-size two- and three-bedroom apartments located on all floors. There are also three 5-bedroom penthouses on the 8th, 9th and 10th floors.

Our Superior Apartments are situated on the ground floor and floors 1-3, the Luxury Apartments on floors 4-6 and the Deluxe Apartments on floors 7-10.

Located on all floors, there are two styles of one-bedroom apartments, overlooking either the Cheval Gloucester Park garden and towards the city’s western edge, or towards central London. The city-facing apartments benefit from a guest cloakroom.

Available in a variety of styles and all featuring private balconies, the two-bedroom apartments at Cheval Gloucester Park comfortably accommodate four guests. The two-bedroom apartments are situated on all floors.

The three-bedroom apartments are the ideal choice for those looking for spacious and luxurious accommodation, whether as a group of friends or when travelling with the whole family.

Enjoy beautiful views of London from one of three balconies looking out from two sides of your apartment in our 5-bedroom Penthouses, located on the upper floors of Cheval Gloucester Park. Comfortably sleeping up to nine adults, and designed with an infusion of mid-century style, our Penthouses offer the lavish comforts of an expansive living space in a highly sought-after London district.

### Superior One-Bedroom Apartment

Perfect for individuals and couples visiting the capital city, our collection of superior one-bedroom apartments at Cheval Gloucester Park are furnished and designed to the highest standard. These apartments are situated on floors one to three.

Each apartment has a fully fitted kitchen with modern appliances as well as a Nespresso machine with capsules. The bedroom includes a King size bed dressed in high-quality linen and pillows, plenty of storage and the en-suite is stocked with complimentary toiletries from L’Occitane.

Selected Superior apartments feature an additional cloakroom accessed from the entrance hallway.

Apartment size: 710-795 sq. ft / 66-74 sqm. Accommodates: 2 guests.

### Luxury One-Bedroom Apartment

Enjoy a stay in the exclusive area of Kensington and relax in stylish surroundings offering both privacy and luxury. Ideal for long and short stays, our luxury one bedroom apartments at Cheval Gloucester Park are perfect for those visiting the capital for business or pleasure. These spacious apartments include a generously sized reception area and feature either city or garden facing views from the private balcony.

Each apartment has a fully fitted kitchen with modern appliances as well as a Nespresso machine with capsules and takeaway cups. The bedroom includes a King size bed dressed in high-quality linen and pillows, plenty of storage and the en-suite is stocked with complimentary toiletries from L’Occitane.

Selected luxury apartments feature an additional cloakroom accessed from the entrance hallway.

Apartment size: 710-795 sq. ft. / 66-74 sqm. Accommodates: 2 guests.

Official virtual apartment tour published for a sample luxury one-bedroom apartment (layouts vary; the published tour features an apartment with separate guest cloakroom). Official floor plans published for a garden-facing Type B apartment and a city-facing Type C apartment.

### Deluxe One-Bedroom Apartment

With spectacular views over central London, the deluxe one-bedroom apartments at Cheval Gloucester Park provide luxurious living space for business or leisure. All apartments are situated on floors seven to 10 and feature a guest cloakroom.

Each apartment has a fully fitted kitchen with modern Miele appliances as well as a Nespresso machine with capsules and takeaway cups. The bedroom includes a King-size bed dressed in high-quality linen and pillows, plenty of storage and the en-suite is stocked with complimentary toiletries from L’Occitane.

Apartment size: 710 sq. ft. / 66 sqm. Accommodates: 2 guests.

### Superior Two-Bedroom Apartment

The superior two-bedroom apartments at Cheval Gloucester Park are perfect for families, couples, friends or colleagues sharing while staying in London for one night or more. These apartments are situated on floors one to three.

Each apartment has a fully fitted kitchen with modern Miele appliances as well as a Nespresso machine with capsules. The king size bed in the Master bedroom along with the twin beds in the second bedroom are dressed in high-quality linen and pillows, plenty of storage and both en-suite bathrooms are stocked with complimentary toiletries from L’Occitane.

Most superior apartments feature an additional cloakroom accessed from the entrance hallway. Note that apartment types D, E, F and G on the first floor do not have a balcony off the Master Bedroom.

Apartment size: 1,139-1,303 sq. ft. / 106-121 sqm. Accommodates: 4 guests.

### Luxury Two-Bedroom Apartment

The luxury two-bedroom apartments at Cheval Gloucester Park are situated on floors four to six with garden or city-facing views. These spacious apartments include a generously sized reception area.

Each apartment has a fully fitted kitchen with modern Miele appliances as well as a Nespresso machine with capsules. The King size beds in the Master Bedroom and second bedroom are dressed in high-quality linen and pillows, with plenty of storage and en-suite bathrooms stocked with complimentary toiletries from L’Occitane.

Most luxury two-bedroom apartments feature an additional cloakroom accessed from the entrance hallway. All the luxury two-bedroom apartments feature a balcony off the reception room. The open plan living space includes a dining area comfortably seating four people. The second bedroom is configured with twin beds. The Master Bedroom in the H-type apartments has a wraparound balcony.

Apartment size: 1,139-1,303 sq. ft. / 106-121 sqm. Accommodates: 4 guests.

Official virtual apartment tour published for a sample luxury two-bedroom apartment (layouts vary). Official floor plans published for dual-aspect types D, E, F and G (with cloakroom), city-facing H-type, and garden-facing J-type (no cloakroom).

### Deluxe Two-Bedroom Apartment

Wake up to beautiful views of Kensington from your deluxe two-bedroom apartment, based on the upper floors of Cheval Gloucester Park. With stylishly decorated spacious living areas and en-suite bathrooms, the deluxe apartment is perfect for stays of up to 4 guests.

Each apartment has a fully fitted kitchen with modern Miele appliances as well as a Nespresso machine with capsules. The King size beds in the Master and 2nd bedrooms are dressed in high-quality linen and pillows, and feature plenty of storage as well as en-suite bathrooms stocked with complimentary toiletries from L’Occitane.

Most deluxe apartments feature an additional cloakroom accessed from the entrance hallway.

Apartment size: 1,139-1,303 sq. ft. / 106-121 sqm. Accommodates: 4 guests.

Official virtual apartment tour published for a sample deluxe two-bedroom apartment (layouts vary). Official floor plans published for dual-aspect types D, E, F, G and H (with cloakroom) and garden-facing J-type (no cloakroom).

### Superior Three-Bedroom Apartment

The superior three-bedroom apartment is the ideal choice for those looking for spacious and luxurious accommodation, whether as a group of friends or when travelling with the whole family. These apartments are situated on floors zero (ground floor) to three. Note that the only apartment on the Ground Floor, apartment 0A, is decorated in a different style to the other three-bedroom apartments. A 360 degree tour illustrates the difference.

All apartments have a fully fitted kitchen with modern Miele appliances as well as a Nespresso machine with capsules. The Master bedroom, 2nd and 3rd bedrooms feature King size beds which can be twinned, and all beds are dressed in high-quality linen and pillows with plenty of storage. En-suite bathrooms are stocked with complimentary luxury toiletries.

The three-bedroom apartment features an additional cloakroom accessed from the entrance hallway. The open plan living area has dining space for six. The bathrooms at Cheval Gloucester Park have underfloor heating and motion sensor lighting. The third bedroom is configured with twin beds that can be linked on request and has an en-suite bathroom.

Apartment size: 1,700 sq. ft. / 158 sqm. Accommodates: 6 guests.

Official virtual apartment tours published for Apartment Type A and Apartment Type K.

### Luxury Three-Bedroom Apartment

The luxury three-bedroom apartments at Cheval Gloucester Park are situated on floors four to six with city and garden-facing views. These spacious apartments include a generously sized reception area and guest cloakroom accessed from the entrance hallway.

Each apartment has a fully fitted kitchen with modern Miele appliances as well as a Nespresso machine with capsules. The Master bedroom, 2nd and 3rd bedrooms feature King size beds which can be twinned, and all beds are dressed in high-quality linen and pillows with plenty of storage. En-suite bathrooms are stocked with complimentary toiletries from L’Occitane.

Every apartment has a balcony immediately off the reception room.

Apartment size: 1,700 sq. ft. / 158 sqm. Accommodates: 6 guests.

Official virtual apartment tour published for a sample luxury three-bedroom apartment (layouts vary). Official floor plans published for Apartment Type A and Apartment Type K.

### Deluxe Three-Bedroom Apartment

With spectacular views towards central London and over Kensington, the deluxe three-bedroom apartments at Cheval Gloucester Park provide luxurious living space for business or leisure. All apartments are situated on floors seven to 10 and feature a guest cloakroom accessed from the entrance hallway.

Each apartment has a fully fitted kitchen with modern Miele appliances as well as a Nespresso machine with capsules. The Master bedroom, 2nd and 3rd bedrooms feature King size beds which can be twinned, and all beds are dressed in high-quality linen and pillows with plenty of storage. En-suite bathrooms are stocked with complimentary toiletries from L’Occitane.

Apartment size: 1,700 sq. ft. / 158 sqm. Accommodates: 6 guests.

Official virtual apartment tour published. Official floor plans published for Apartment Type A and Apartment Type K.

### Five-Bedroom Penthouse

Enjoy beautiful views of London from one of three balconies looking out from two sides of your apartment in our 5-bedroom Penthouses, located on the upper floors of Cheval Gloucester Park.

Comfortably sleeping up to nine adults, and designed with an infusion of mid-century style, our Penthouses offer the lavish comforts of an expansive living space in a highly sought-after London district.

The penthouses feature an open-plan living space with a designated dining area opening-up to two furnished balconies, which perfectly set the scene for your exclusive London apartment.

The generously spacious en-suite master bedroom houses a king-size bed along with plenty of storage space for your convenience. The second en-suite bedroom also features a king size bed and a balcony overlooking scenic London views. Two further en-suite twin rooms lie on the opposing side of the apartment as well as an additional single bedroom – all bathrooms are supplied with L’Occitane toiletries and luxury amenities to enhance your stay.

Perfect for families, our Penthouses provide the best in luxury living with air-conditioning throughout as well as 24-hour service for your utmost comfort and security.

Penthouse size: 2,495 sq. ft / 232 sqm. Accommodates: 9 guests.

The penthouses are located on floors 8, 9 and 10, and follow an identical layout. Official virtual apartment tour and official floor plan published.

## Private cinema (The Picture House)

Check out the latest cinema releases, watch sporting events live or indulge in a classic film in the comfort of Cheval Gloucester Park’s private cinema, with luxurious seating for up to 12 guests in a three-tiered layout.

Located on the ground floor, this unique space offers the ultimate screening experience for your friends and family. Guests can fully immerse themselves in the cinematic world with a 2.4m (108”) wide screen projecting a crystal clear 4k resolution, enhanced by an exceptional surround sound system.

The cinema is normally only available for resident guests and must be pre-booked with the front office team. A dedicated iPad Mini can be used to control the audio and video systems. To ensure optimum performance, surface mounted acoustic treatments have been installed to ‘tune’ the room.

## Extended stays

Enjoy unparalleled views of London city night after night, from one of our extended stay five-star apartments at Cheval Gloucester Park. Each of them is stunning designed and fully equipped for your long-term accommodation needs. Whether you’re staying in the capital for business, family or leisure, our residences at Cheval Gloucester Park will exceed all your expectations.

You’ll be able to explore the boutiques of Kensington, relish the art and culture of Knightsbridge and stroll through London’s royal parks, all during an unforgettable extended stay.

Our serviced apartments at Cheval Gloucester Road range from comfortable one-bedroom homes to exclusive luxury penthouses. Other amenities at Cheval Gloucester Road include 24-hour security, 24-hour complimentary WIFI and a weekly housekeeping service.

The dedicated Central Reservations Team is available to help guests with all their requirements. Contact +44(0)20 7341 7052 or complete the official online Enquiry Form.

## Neighbourhood

Popular amongst tourists and even local Londoners, Kensington is an upscale district in London with stately Victorian buildings, galleries and embassies. Home to three of London’s largest and most famous museums, this area offers plenty to view and explore all-year round. As well as enjoying the serenity of the Royal gardens and world-renowned Hyde Park, Kensington hosts an eclectic shopping scene too- filled with gorgeous designer boutiques and brands.

Those with a taste for fine music can visit the famous Royal Albert Hall in South Kensington, a concert hall which has held the Prom concerts annually each summer since 1941. There are also plenty of exhibitions held at Olympia London, a venue that regularly hosts a range of international conferences and events.

Contrary to popular belief, many of the museums and sights in Kensington offer free entry for visitors, meaning that this affluent area is available for almost anyone to enjoy.

Many attractions near to Cheval Gloucester Park are within walking distance, but we are also extremely close to an underground station, Gloucester Road. A frequent service means you can be virtually anywhere in the central zone in about 20 to 25 minutes. The Piccadilly line also services London’s Heathrow Airport directly, with journey times of approximately 55 minutes.

Official nearby distances: Gloucester Road underground station (220m); Natural History Museum (850m); Victoria & Albert Museum (1km); Science Museum (1.1km); Hyde Park (1km); Royal Albert Hall (1.2km); Kensington Gardens (1.2km); The Design Museum (1.5km); Harrods (1.7km); Buckingham Palace (3.7km).

## Contact and service

Whether you’re looking to book a stay at Cheval Gloucester Park or have a request during your stay, you can get in touch with our team using the details below. The Residence has housekeeping and maintenance teams on site, and our knowledgeable Front Office team is available 24 hours a day.

description:
Situated on the banks of the River Thames immediately adjacent to the Tower of London and just a short walk from Tower Hill Underground Station, Cheval Three Quays features a selection of 159 modern luxury apartments, available to book for any length of stay. Cheval Three Quays has a range of accommodation, from intelligently designed studio and open-plan apartments to grand penthouses with views of some of London’s most iconic landmarks, including The Shard and HMS Belfast. Whether you’re staying for just one night, or for months at a time, you can expect five-star service and the personal touch.

Choosing to stay in an apartment during your visit to London means you’ll have all the extra space you deserve in a secure environment, complemented by our 24-hour front office team who can assist with restaurant reservations, theatre bookings, transport and more.

## About the residence

Situated on the banks of the River Thames in an area rich with history, Cheval Three Quays features a selection of 159 modern luxury apartments, available to book for any length of stay. Cheval Three Quays has a range of accommodation available, from intelligently designed studio and open-plan apartments to grand penthouses with views of some of London’s most iconic landmarks. Whether you’re staying at a Cheval Residence for just one night, or for months at a time, you can expect five-star service and the personal touch.

The building first opened its doors to the public in 2014, and its location immediately adjacent to the Tower of London has made it a firm favourite for visitors looking to explore this vibrant and ever-changing area. The design of the building acknowledges the site’s original use as a set of docks for unloading tobacco and other cargo arriving from the West Indies. In contrast to the relative calm of the River Thames we experience today, as recently as the mid-20th century this was a busy industrial area.

Choosing to stay in an apartment during your visit to London means you’ll have all the extra space you deserve in a secure environment, complemented by our 24-hour concierge team who can assist with helping you navigate the city, be it for restaurant reservations, theatre bookings, transport and more.

You are welcome to book a stay directly via our website, or you can contact our reservations team who will be happy to explain the different options available. With over 35 years’ operation, our experienced team can provide you with peace of mind so that every element of your stay meets your expectations.

Cheval Three Quays is part of Cheval Residences, a portfolio of high-quality, luxury apartments in prime locations in central London, with locations in the West and East ends of the city. Every apartment comes equipped with a full-sized kitchen to enable you to enjoy the comforts of home during your stay.

## Apartment types

Explore our apartments. description:
Soak up London’s vibrant culture whilst living in one of the city’s most exclusive areas. At Cheval Knightsbridge our apartments are situated in various locations around the Knightsbridge village, usually no more than two minutes’ walk from our 24-hour reception at 15 Cheval Place.

Accommodation can be booked for any length of stay, and all apartments have fully equipped kitchens. At check-in all guests will be escorted to their apartment by a member of our team.

Our apartments at Cheval Knightsbridge are full of character. Each mews house, townhouse, apartment or cottage boasts its own personality and style of décor. Landmarks such as the Victoria and Albert Museum and Natural History Museum are both a short walk away, as are the shops and boutiques of Knightsbridge itself.

Choosing to stay in an apartment at Cheval Knightsbridge during your visit to London means you’ll have all the extra space you deserve along with all the services you would expect at home, complemented by our 24-hour front office team who can assist with restaurant reservations, theatre bookings, transport and more.

The official gallery page also publishes: Soak up London’s vibrant culture whilst living in one of the city’s most exclusive areas. At Cheval Knightsbridge our apartments are situated in various locations around the Knightsbridge village, usually no more than two minutes’ walk from our 24-hour reception at 15 Cheval Place. Accommodation can be booked for any length of stay, from just one night to several weeks, months or even years. At check-in all guests will be escorted to their apartment by a member of our team.

Cheval Knightsbridge is currently made up of 49 luxury serviced apartments, available for stays of one night, or for any length of stay in some of our extended stay accommodation.

## About the residence

The Cheval story began in the vibrant streets of Knightsbridge, to the west of central London.

We opened our first property in 1982 in Cheval Place, a quiet street in the heart of Knightsbridge set back from the bustling Brompton Road, home to some of London’s most iconic shopping destinations.

Knightsbridge itself is named after an ancient bridge spanning the Westbourne Stream, and as the first half of the word implies, was the gathering point of knights and their retainers. These knights would have required somewhere to stable their horses, suggesting that Cheval Place, from the French for horse, was aptly named.

The first set of apartments, at 21-25a Cheval Place, became available to book in 1982. A number of apartments in Montpelier Mews were added to the collection in 1989, followed by a further set on Brompton Road, Cheval Place and additional stock in Montpelier Mews in 1995.

In 2008 number 38 Cheval Place was unveiled, and in 2015 even more flats on Brompton Road joined the portfolio. Most recently, the four-bedroom townhouse at Cheval Place was renovated and relaunched in 2017, and a set of one bedroom deluxe apartments opened at 29-31 Cheval Place in 2018.

Cheval Knightsbridge is currently made up of 49 luxury serviced apartments, available for stays of one night, or for any length of stay in some of our extended stay accommodation.

Just seconds from the many delights of this prestigious neighbourhood, a Cheval Knightsbridge residence is as individual as you are. Choose from chic two-bedroom apartments, mews houses or a sleek four-floor townhouse – each one utterly distinctive.

Step inside and discover cleverly planned interiors, secluded courtyards and rich furnishings. Step outside and enjoy some of the world’s most iconic brands, shops and restaurants – right on your doorstep.

Cheval Knightsbridge has a collection of mew houses, apartments, townhouses, garden villas and city cottages centred on Cheval Place, a quiet residential street parallel to the bustling Brompton Road. A range of accommodation is available, from one bedroom apartments to our flagship four bedroom townhouse that’s guaranteed to impress.

Minutes away from the greenery of Hyde Park and nestled between London’s most sophisticated museums and galleries, stands Cheval Thorney Court, one of Cheval Collection’s most luxurious residences, with 59 extremely spacious apartments available to book for any length of stay.

Against the backdrop of traditional British Georgian period décor, you will be ideally placed to discover the Royal Borough of Kensington, a district renowned for its exclusivity and undeniable appeal.

All apartments at Cheval Thorney Court have fully equipped kitchens as well as washing machines and separate space for living and dining. The Front Office is staffed 24 hours a day, and guests can expect daily housekeeping service.

Choosing to stay in an apartment at Cheval Thorney Court during your visit to London means you’ll have all the extra space you deserve along with all the services you would expect at home, complemented by our 24-hour front office team who can assist with restaurant reservations, theatre bookings, transport and more.

## About the residence

The Cheval story began in the vibrant streets of Knightsbridge, to the west of central London and only a 20 minute walk from Cheval Gloucester Park. As an organisation we acquired our first property in 1981 in Cheval Place, a quiet street in the heart of Knightsbridge set back from the bustling Brompton Road, and home to some of London’s most iconic shopping destinations. This was to form the heart of our Cheval Knightsbridge Residence.

Knightsbridge itself is named after an ancient bridge spanning the Westbourne Stream, and as the first half of the word implies, was the gathering point of knights and their retainers. These knights would have required somewhere to stable their horses, suggesting that Cheval Place, from the French for horse, was aptly named.

Cheval Thorney Court joined the portfolio in 1995 and is distinguished by its traditional décor, modelled on the Regency Period from the early decades of the 19th century. The furnishings of this time were elegant and detailed, set against characteristic striped wallpaper in bright colours.

From its impressive position on the corner of Palace Gate and Kensington Road, the Residence is currently made up of 59 luxury serviced apartments, available for stays of one night, one month, or longer depending on your requirements.

Step inside Cheval Thorney Court and discover all the charm of an English stately home or grand townhouse, right in the heart of London. Each spacious apartment exudes quality, blending traditional craftsmanship with discrete service and the utmost level of privacy.

Overlooking Kensington Palace Gardens, you’re just moments away from the Royal Albert Hall, Hyde Park, Harrods, the Natural History Museum and the Victoria and Albert Museum. The finest company you could wish for.

## About the residence

The official About Us page publishes the Cheval origin story for this residence: The Cheval story began in the vibrant streets of Knightsbridge, to the west of central London. As an organisation we acquired our first property in 1981 in Cheval Place, a quiet street set back from the bustling Brompton Road, and home to some of London’s most iconic shopping destinations.

Knightsbridge itself is named after an ancient bridge spanning the Westbourne Stream, and as the first half of the word implies, was the gathering point of knights and their retainers. These knights would have required somewhere to stable their horses, suggesting that Cheval Place, from the French for horse, was aptly named.

Cheval Harrington Court joined the Cheval Residences portfolio in 2014 after a modest refurbishment (it was previously operating as serviced apartments), offering 47 open plan, 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments. The building was for a time the childhood home of Sir Andrew Lloyd Webber, famous for a series of internationally successful musicals he composed, including Joseph and the Amazing Technicolor Dreamcoat, Evita, Cats and The Phantom of the Opera.

Many of his works have been on stage in London’s West End theatre district for more than a decade. Lloyd Webber recently revisited Harrington Court for a BBC2 documentary about his life.

description:
Welcome to Lexham Gardens by Cheval Maison, our Serviced Apartments in Kensington an unrivalled and luxury stay experience in the heart of London.

Lexham Gardens by Cheval Maison is an all-apartment boutique property located in the heart of Kensington and only a short distance from Gloucester Road underground station. Featuring the iconic white columned façade famously found in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, this stylish property features 30 beautifully designed one- and two-bedroom apartments spread over six floors.

Each apartment is luxuriously furnished and features one of three creative themes in a nod to the quintessentially British feel of the local area: racing green, glamorous red and cool neutral equestrian. The on-site fitness centre is available 24 hours a day, and the landscaped garden brings a calm oasis to this vibrant, up-market district.

Apartments have fully-equipped kitchens with high-tech appliances, as well as all the luxuries to enhance your stay, and are available to book for any length of stay.

Official homepage image captions: A spacious living with a Racing Green décor; The traditional Kensington façade of the property; The living dining area in a Royal Red apartment; The third style, neutral equestrian at Lexham Gardens; Modern bathrooms with complimentary toiletries; A fully equipped gym accessible 24 hours a day; All apartments have full kitchens; Beds are dressed with high quality linens.

Features and amenities — At a glance: All-apartment accommodation; Fully equipped kitchens; Free Wi-Fi; 24-hour reception; 24-hour complimentary gym; Washing machine and dryer; Complimentary toiletries; Air-conditioned; Communal garden at rear.

Choosing to stay in an apartment at Lexham Gardens by Cheval Maison during your visit to London means you’ll have all the extra space you deserve along with all the services you would expect at home, complemented by our 24-hour front office team who can assist with restaurant reservations, theatre bookings, transport and more.

Official nearby sights and attractions: Gloucester Road Underground Station (750m); High Street Kensington Underground Station (850m); Kensington Palace (1.1km); The Design Museum (1.1km); Science Museum (1.1km); Royal Albert Hall (1.3km); Natural History Museum (1.4km); Victoria & Albert Museum (1.4km); Harrods (2.2km); Buckingham Palace (4.2km).

Official accommodation listed on the property homepage: Superior One-Bedroom Apartments (Decorated in Racing Green); Luxury One-Bedroom Apartments (Luxury living for two); Deluxe One-Bedroom Apartments (Situated on the 1st floor); Superior Two-Bedroom Apartments (Cool neutral equestrian style); Luxury Two-Bedroom Apartments (Royal Red and Cool Equestrian); Deluxe Two-Bedroom Apartments (Situated on the upper floors).

The official gallery page also publishes: Lexham Gardens by Cheval Maison is an all-apartment boutique property located in the heart of Kensington and only a short distance from Gloucester Road underground station. Featuring the iconic white columned façade famously found in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, this stylish property features 30 beautifully designed one- and two-bedroom apartments spread over six floors.

Official gallery captions: Façade - Lexham Gardens by Cheval Maison; Building Entrance - Lexham Gardens by Cheval Maison; Luxury Two-Bedroom Apartment – Royal Red; Superior One-Bedroom Apartments – British Racing Heritage; Sofa Bed – Superior One-Bedroom Apartments – British Racing Heritage; Luxury Two-Bedroom Apartment – Cool Equestrian; Fitness Suite; Reception Lounge Area; Private Garden.

## About the residence

The official About Us page publishes: In the heart of Kensington, this boutique residence consists of 30 stylishly designed serviced apartments, offering the very best in luxury living.

The property welcomes guests via large projecting open porches, offering the choice of one- and two-bedroom apartments with bright windows, some of which look out onto the leafy manicured garden and others toward the iconic Victorian terraces at the front of the property. Three contemporary colour themes adorn the apartments, Racing Green, Luxurious Royal Red and Cool Neutral Equestrian; each one expressing the quintessentially British history of the local area whilst showcasing the very best in stylish modern design.

The iconic property spans 32-38 Lexham Gardens and dates to the mid-Victorian era (1875-84), a time of prosperity following the industrial revolution. Many buildings of this architectural period are known for their classical style, but this period also saw the revival of medieval Gothic architectural elements and those found across Europe.

Completed by two different builders over the 9-year period, William Ashfold and William Douglas, Lexham Gardens by Cheval Maison has retained its iconic Classical-Italianate style whilst displaying slight variation, making it a valuable part of the Lexham Gardens Conservation area, developed by the third Lord Kensington.

The fashionable area quickly became known as a prime location for the wealthy elite after Kensington Palace (previously known as Nottingham House) was purchased and renovated by William III and retains its reputation today as a desired upmarket location for residents and visitors alike, with many high-end shops, restaurants and notably London’s iconic galleries and museums within walking distance to the Maison.

In 2021 Lexham Gardens by Cheval Maison joined Cheval Collection as the first Maison property in the Cheval Collection portfolio, a luxury serviced apartment operator with properties in London, Edinburgh and Dubai.

Official key date published on the About Us page: 2021 – Lexham Gardens by Cheval Maison joined Cheval Collection as the first Maison property.

The official contact page also publishes: Whether you’re looking to book an apartment at Lexham Gardens by Cheval Maison or have a request during your stay, you can get in touch with our team using the details below. Ian James – General Manager.

The fashionable area retains its reputation today as a desired upmarket location for residents and visitors alike, with many high-end shops, restaurants and notably London’s iconic galleries and museums within walking distance to the Maison.

## Apartment types

The 30 one- and two-bedroom apartments at Lexham Gardens are arranged on all floors of the building, and each is decorated in a Racing Green, Royal Red or Cool Equestrian style. There are two luxury one-bedroom apartments on the ground floor facing the communal garden which have small, private terraces. Some of the apartments on the upper floors have a dual aspect, with views over the square to the front and the garden to the rear.

The superior and luxury one-bedroom apartments are located on the lower ground and ground floors. Two of the luxury one-bedroom apartments have a private patio space facing into the communal garden. The Deluxe one-bedroom apartments have additional space and are situated on the first floor.

Guests will find the superior two-bedroom apartments on various floors, all decorated in the cool Neutral Equestrian theme. The luxury two-bedroom apartments are dressed either in Royal Red or Neutral Equestrian décor, with more space than the superior apartments. Both the superior and luxury two-bedroom apartments comfortably accommodate three adults, with space for a fourth adult on a sofa bed in the living room. The deluxe two-bedroom apartments are located on the upper floors, with two spacious bedrooms easily accommodating four adults.

Please note floorplan measurements and furniture placements are approximate and may not be to scale. ## About the residence

The Cheval story began in the vibrant streets of Knightsbridge, to the west of central London and only a 20 minute walk from Cheval Gloucester Park. As an organisation we acquired our first property in 1981 in Cheval Place, a quiet street in the heart of Knightsbridge set back from the bustling Brompton Road, and home to some of London’s most iconic shopping destinations. This was to form the heart of our Cheval Knightsbridge Residence.

Knightsbridge itself is named after an ancient bridge spanning the Westbourne Stream, and as the first half of the word implies, was the gathering point of knights and their retainers. These knights would have required somewhere to stable their horses, suggesting that Cheval Place, from the French for horse, was aptly named.

Cheval Hyde Park Gate joined the portfolio in 1995 and is the smallest of our Residences, but by far the grandest. The stucco-fronted period structure dates from the mid-1840s, and was built by the renowned civil engineering firm of Grissell and Peto. The firm was also responsible for some of the building work at the Houses of Parliament, as well as some significant parts of the fast-expanding railway system of that era.

Much of the furniture and fittings found in the apartments are from the furniture firm Charles Barr, who set up a business in the 1860s. The company’s fortunes waned over time, but in the late 1940s a new workshop was established and production of the Regency and Edwardian styles began again, still bearing the original founder’s name. The exception to this style is two apartments on the lower ground floor of the building which are decorated and furnished in a fresh, contemporary style.

## Neighbourhood

Popular amongst tourists and even local Londoners, Kensington is an upscale district in London with stately Victorian buildings, galleries and embassies. Home to three of London’s largest and most famous museums, this area offers plenty to view and explore all-year round. As well as enjoying the serenity of the Royal gardens and world-renowned Hyde Park, Kensington hosts an eclectic shopping scene too- filled with gorgeous designer boutiques and brands.

Those with a taste for fine music can visit the famous Royal Albert Hall in South Kensington, a concert hall which has held the Prom concerts annually each summer since 1941. There are also plenty of exhibitions held at Olympia London, a venue that regularly hosts a range of international conferences and events.

Contrary to popular belief, many of the museums and sights in Kensington offer free entry for visitors, meaning that this affluent area is available for almost anyone to enjoy.

Welcome to the bustling heart of the capital. Situated just off Bow Lane and its intriguing mix of lanes and courtyards, is Cheval Calico House, home to 47 exclusive five-star apartments. You’ll be living near St Paul’s Cathedral, the Bank of England and the contemporary, world-famous Tate Modern.

Our collection of apartments at Cheval Calico House makes for the perfect extended-stay home, with apartments available for stays of three or more months*. All the essentials you’d expect in a five-star Residence are here: high-speed complimentary WiFi, flat-screen TVs and use of modern everyday appliances. Our 24-hour front office team will ensure that your stay in the capital exceeds your expectations with on-site management and a professional housekeeping service.

*Three months is our normal minimum length of stay, however there are times when short stays of a few nights are possible, usually with a minimum stay requirement of two nights. Keep an eye on our website for availability or speak to our reservations team.

Choosing to stay at Cheval Calico House during your visit to London means you’ll have all the extra space you deserve along with all the services you would expect at home. All utility bills and services are included in our competitive rates, and our 24-hour front office team can assist with restaurant reservations, theatre bookings, transport and more.

The official gallery page also publishes: Situated just off Bow Lane and its intriguing mix of lanes and courtyards, is Cheval Calico House, home to 47 exclusive five-star apartments. You’ll be living near St Paul’s Cathedral, the Bank of England and the contemporary, world-famous Tate Modern.

The official About Us page publishes 45 exclusive five-star apartments (the homepage and gallery publish 47) and adds docking stations among the in-residence essentials, with a 24-hour Concierge team.

Tucked away in a quiet courtyard, Cheval Calico House is your sanctuary in the heart of the city’s financial district. Inside you are cocooned in comfort and style, peacefully removed from the capital’s markets and meetings. Meanwhile, nearby, are the lively bars and restaurants of Bow Lane and Europe’s bustling business centre.

## About the residence

The Cheval story began in the vibrant streets of Knightsbridge, to the west of central London and only a 20 minute walk from Cheval Thorney Court. As an organisation, we opened our first property in 1981 in Cheval Place, a quiet street in the heart of Knightsbridge set back from the bustling Brompton Road, and home to some of London’s most iconic shopping destinations. This was to form the heart of our Cheval Knightsbridge Residence.

Knightsbridge itself is named after an ancient bridge spanning the Westbourne Stream, and as the first half of the word implies, was the gathering point of knights and their retainers. These knights would have required somewhere to stable their horses, suggesting that Cheval Place, from the French for horse, was aptly named.

Official key dates for when each Residence joined the Cheval portfolio: 1981 – The first apartments open at Cheval Knightsbridge; 1991 – Cheval Gloucester Park opens; 1995 – Cheval Thorney Court opens; 1995 – Cheval Hyde Park Gate opens; 2001 – Cheval Calico House opens; 2003 – Cheval Phoenix House opens; 2014 – Cheval Harrington Court opens after refurbishment; 2014 – Cheval Three Quays opens; 2019 – Cheval Gloucester Park reopens after a major two-year refurbishment.

Cheval Calico House opened in 2001. The official apartment-types page publishes 45 exclusive luxury apartments just off Bow Lane; the homepage, gallery and contact pages publish 47 exclusive apartments.

## Neighbourhood

Cheval Phoenix House is within walking distance of a number of local attractions, including the boutiques, shops and restaurants on Sloane Street and the King’s Road. Sloane Square underground station, with easy access to central London, is less than a 5-minute walk.

Official nearby distances: Cadogan Hall (85m); Peter Jones & Partners (270m); Sloane Square Underground Station (300m); Saatchi Gallery (400m); Harvey Nichols (900m); Harrods (900m); Hyde Park (1.1km); Victoria Albert Museum (1.4km); Natural History Museum (1.7km); Science Museum (1.8km).

Initially a Saxon Village (where its name derives from), Chelsea became an affluent district during the 16th and 17th century. Interestingly, the famous “Kings Road” was named during this period, as it was once a private road leading to the Royal Palace and Hampton Court. Sloane Square picked up its name from Sir Hans Sloane, who was a physician to the Kings and Queens of the 17th century.

The world-famous “Chelsea Pensioners”, who still wear a uniform of scarlet coats and tricorn hats to this very day, once resided at The Royal Hospital Chelsea, upon retirement from the British Army. This landmark was built by Sir Christopher Wren, one of Britain’s most distinguished architects.

Chelsea is also known for the famous writers, artists and poets who once lived there, such as Oscar Wilde and James McNeill. This is why the district now hosts cutting-edge theatre and some of the finest galleries.

FAQs
Do you offer corporate rates?
Yes, we certainly do. For further information please contact the sales team on + 44 (0) 207 378 4840 and press 2, or email sales@marlin.com

Can I have a party in the apartment?
Marlin has a strict no-party policy. The maximum number of people per apartment should not be exceeded and noise levels must not cause a disturbance to other guests. Additional charges will be levied to your account if there is evidence of a party having occurred during your stay.
The maximum room occupancy for each apartment type must be strictly adhered to.

How much do you charge for car parking?
We offer car parking at three of our family apartment hotels in London, with the following competitive daily rates:
· Empire Square: £30 per day
· Canary Wharf: £20 per day
· Aldgate: £25 per day (Temporarily unavailable)
Please bear in mind that spaces are limited and require advanced booking. If our on-site parking is fully booked, we’ll be happy to give you the details of a nearby public car park.

How do I check in and collect my keys?
We have a 24 hour concierge so once you check-in your keys will be given to you. Standard check-in time is from 3pm onwards but you can check in from 11am at an additional cost of £30, or between 8am and 11am an additional cost of £60.

Smoking & Vaping: Smoking or vaping is not permitted within the building. Under the Health Act 2006 it is an offence to smoke, or permit someone else to smoke, within the premises which includes the balconies. If you break this rule, you will have to pay a £250 fine.
Property Access: The apartment building doors are locked each day after 23:00. Access after this time is by residents’ keycards or by contacting the front desk team from the outside intercom system.
Kettle, Tea & Coffee: Each room is equipped with an assortment of traditional British tea and a Nespresso coffee machine, provided complimentary as a warm welcome to all our guests. If you would like additional pods, they are available for purchase at Reception at a very affordable price.
Laundry: All our units have a washer/dryer, except for the Studio Deluxe apartments. We also work with a selected external dry-cleaning company that can provide laundry and dry-cleaning services as you need them during your stay. To use this service, please fill out the form in your wardrobe, put the garments in the laundry bag provided, and hand it to our front desk team by 10am. We will return your clothes the next working day from Monday to Friday unless you request otherwise.
Check-In and Check-Out Information: Check-in is available from 16:00, and check-out is by 11:00. Early check-ins and late check-outs can be guaranteed for an additional fee.
Electricity Supply: Our property operates on a European standard voltage of 240v. The majority of our rooms feature a built-in adaptor in the hub situated above the desk. This hub also includes USB sockets.
Pet Policy: Service animals such as guide dogs are always welcome at Fraser Place Canary Wharf, other pets only by prior Management approval. London is a dog-friendly city. Dogs on leashes are allowed on buses, and there are plenty of dog-friendly restaurants, pubs, and cafes.
Housekeeping Policy: Your apartment will be cleaned every other day for stays of six nights or less, and once a week for stays of seven nights or more. Please note that we do not provide cleaning on weekends or public holidays. Should you require additional cleaning, it can be arranged for an extra fee starting at £35.
Baby Cot: For those journeying with a little one, we provide cots across all our room categories.
WiFi: You can connect as many devices as you want and surf the internet freely. You will have received in this email your login credentials for your own Personal Entertainment Network (PEN).

Official FAQ (selected official answers printed on faq / directory/faq pages)
What is the cancellation policy at Fraser Place Canary Wharf? Cancellations can be made 48 hours before check-in.
How do you ensure environmental sustainability at Fraser Suites Canary Wharf? We were awarded bronze status on our first inspection by Green Tourism, something that we are proud of as we continue our journey towards sustainability. We were credited for our efforts in: Mindful waste reduction; Responsible water usage; Energy efficiency; Promotion of local biodiversity.
What type of beds are provided in the apartments at Fraser Place Canary Wharf? The apartments at Fraser Place Canary Wharf are furnished with king-sized beds. (Apartment pages print Queen Size Bed / Three Queen Beds. Both wordings are official.)
How do you ensure… Green Tourism bronze; official homepage also prints GREEN TOURISM ACCREDITED.
What is the Accommodation Tax at Fraser Place Canary Wharf? The Accommodation Tax is 20% and drops to 4% on the 29th day.
Is Fraser Place Canary Wharf good for long stays? Fraser Place Canary Wharf has been designed for long stays, with its spacious apartments, kitchen facilities, unbeatable location and great rates.
Do the apartments at Fraser Place Canary Wharf have balconies? Yes, selected apartments at Fraser Place Canary offer balconies with panoramic river or city views.
What are the views like from Fraser Place Canary Wharf? Many of the apartments enjoy views of the River Thames, as well as of the surrounding harbour, marina and city.
How far is Fraser Place Canary Wharf from the centre of London? Our property is 5 miles (8 km) from the centre of London and just a short ride by tube.
How do I get to Fraser Place Canary Wharf? Fraser Place Canary Wharf is located at 80 Boardwalk Place, London E14 5SF, and is easily accessible by Taxi, Train or Car.
What is the maximum number of guests allowed in each residence type at Fraser Place Canary Wharf? A maximum of 2 guests can occupy the Studio apartment, a maximum of 4 guests can occupy the One Bedroom apartment, and a maximum of 6 guests can occupy the Two Bedroom apartment.
Are there accessible apartments at Fraser Place Canary Wharf? Unfortunately, Fraser Place Canary Wharf does not have accessible rooms but there is step-free access to the reception.
What are the reception’s operating hours at Fraser Place Canary Wharf? The reception is open 24 hours for your convenience.
What are the services and facilities offered at Fraser Place Canary Wharf? At Fraser Place Canary Wharf, guests can enjoy use of the Exercise room and reception area with sales of soft drinks and complimentary tea and coffee.
Does Fraser Place Canary Wharf have an official hygiene accreditation? Fraser Place Canary Wharf has been awarded hygiene accreditation from SGS, ASSAP and AA.
What languages are spoken by the staff at Fraser Place Canary Wharf? Our staff are fluent in multiple languages for the convenience of international guests.
Can I store my luggage before check-in at Fraser Place Canary Wharf? Definitely. Please approach our front desk team for assistance.
What are the payment modes available at Fraser Place Canary Wharf? We accept payment by Cash, Credit card, Debit card and Bank transfer.
Is there an airport shuttle service at Fraser Place Canary Wharf? An airport shuttle service is not available. A private limousine service may be arranged at an extra charge.
Can I walk to the O2 from Fraser Place Canary Wharf? O2 is located on the south of the River Thames, with Fraser Place on the north. It’s a little far to walk, so we recommend taking the tube from Canary Wharf station to North Greenwich, just one stop away on the Jubilee line. It takes less than two minutes, after which the O2 is another few minutes’ walk from North Greenwich station.
Nearest bank, ATM and exchange office: a 6-minute walk from Fraser Place Canary Wharf in the Canary Wharf shopping centre.
Official historical sites printed: Tower of London (2.8 miles or 4.5 km); Houses of Parliament (4.9 miles or 7.9km); Old Royal Naval College (1.5 miles or 2.4 km).

Official history (FAQ): Grosvenor House Suites occupies a storied address on London’s iconic Park Lane – the tree-lined avenue facing Hyde Park, which in the 19th century became a byword for elegance and exclusivity. This was the site of Grosvenor House – the palatial London home of the Grosvenors, the dynasty which over three centuries has created many of the city’s finest streets and squares and which made Mayfair London’s most prestigious quarter.

Built in the 1800s on the site of an earlier royal residence by Robert Grosvenor, 1st Marquess of Westminster, Grosvenor House was perhaps London’s grandest townhouse – the heart of London’s social scene and home to one of the world’s great private art collections.

As The Times declared in 1808, Grosvenor House combined “magnificence, elegance, and convenience” – qualities that Grosvenor House Suites still retain to this day. In the 1920s, when the Grosvenors downsized to a smaller Mayfair townhouse in keeping with the mood of the times, the visionary developer Arthur Octavius Edwards created the grandest and newest of grand hotels on the site, which combined luxurious modernity with its predecessor’s handsome Georgian lines and sash windows.

Today, Grosvenor House Suites still occupies the smartest address in London: Park Lane on the corner with Mount Street. And it is this combination of glorious heritage, perfect location and the finest traditions of British excellence and service which inform a contemporary vision of luxury at Grosvenor House Suites today.

Official FAQ amenities and services (verbatim answers):
What type of luxury accommodation does Grosvenor House Suites offer in London? From airy studios to elegant three-bedroom suites and penthouses, our luxury suites offer flexible accommodation to everyone travelling to London. Luxurious proportions are combined with bespoke 5-star service and fully equipped kitchens, along with comfortable living, entertaining and sleeping areas. All needs are met, whether you are a lone traveller or a family group looking for luxury serviced accommodations in the heart of the city.
What type of luxury amenities can guests enjoy at Grosvenor House Suites? We offer all amenities guests expect from a 5* luxury hotel from Concierge services to an all-day dining restaurant to Room Service, a gym and much more.
Is there a concierge service at Grosvenor House Suites? Yes, our luxury suites and penthouses come with a highly trained concierge team that will be happy to arrange anything for you during your stay at Grosvenor House Suites.
Is there a butler service at Grosvenor House Suites? Yes, this can be arranged upon request.
Is there a gym or fitness facility at Grosvenor House Suites? Yes, there is a gym available for our guests with fitness classes and personal trainer services upon request.
Are any cleaning services offered at Grosvenor House Suites? Yes, our cleaning services are carried out twice a day.
Does Grosvenor House Suites offer parking? Our Concierge team will be pleased to have your vehicle parked and collected. Please note that the vehicle will be parked offsite at a public car park and is at the sole risk of the owner. Grosvenor House Suites bears no liability for any loss or damage to the vehicle and its contents. Please note, congestion charges and valet parking charges may apply.
What are the security measures in place at Grosvenor House Suites? Grosvenor House Suites provides a high level of security for all guests. The building features controlled access to guest floors and lobby lounge, 24‑hour reception, and continuous CCTV monitoring in key areas. Our on‑site team is trained to ensure a safe, discreet, and comfortable environment throughout your stay. While we do not share specific security protocols for safety reasons, guest wellbeing is always our top priority.
Does Grosvenor House Suites accommodate medical stays? Grosvenor House Suites is pleased to welcome guests visiting London for medical treatments, consultations, or recovery periods. Our discreet, residential‑style environment and personalised service create a calm and comfortable setting for guests requiring additional privacy and care.

Official sustainability policy: Grosvenor House Suites is dedicated to minimising the negative impact of its activities on the natural world and transitioning to a circular economy. We work closely with the prestigious eco-label Green Key to integrate sustainability across all departments. Green Key is a leading standard of excellence in the field of sustainable hospitality, receiving high recognition by both the World Tourism Organisation (UNWTO), and the Global Sustainable Tourism Council. Our dedicated Green Team drives sustainable initiatives at GHS in accordance with the following aims:
1. To monitor and offset our carbon footprint to reach science-based targets. Currently we: Calculate our annual Carbon footprint; Incorporate innovative vegetarian and vegan dishes into our menus. We plan to: Switch to Ecosia search engine in our office spaces to support tree planting initiatives worldwide; Partner with Hotels for Trees to give guests the opportunity to carbon offset their stay.
2. To reduce our carbon emissions through efficiency improvements. So far we have: Replaced over 50% of our lights with LEDs which are safer, more efficient and reliable; Installed light sensors across all back of house areas, including meeting rooms and corridors. We plan to: Closely monitor and reduce our energy consumption using the platform Engie; Install energy efficient equipment throughout our hotel as part of future renovation.
3. To practice water stewardship. Currently we: Only use accredited Ecolab cleaning products; Retrofitted time-sensitive water taps in Back of House areas; Offer tap water to guests. We plan to: Introduce an opt-in linen and towel reuse programme to save laundry water.
4. To adopt the hierarchy of waste reduction, reuse of materials and recycling to minimise waste disposal. Currently we: Partner with Grundon waste to ensure none of our waste is sent to landfill; Use organic hemp oil in our kitchens which is then recycled; Separate our glass waste on site; Minimise our single use tableware, opting instead for cotton napkins and bamboo straws; Return our guest laundry in tissue paper rather than plastic covers; Recycle our printer cartridges; Provide glass rather than plastic bottled water to our guests to minimise plastic waste; Are moving towards a paper-free future by providing guest information on in-room tablets and digital newspapers; Use refillable hand-lotion and shower gel bottles to reduce our plastic waste; We offer access to charge electric vehicles. We plan to: Separate our waste on site to accurately monitor our waste production; Eliminate excess packaging on our in-house laundered items; Introduce digital check-ins.
5. To maintain a diverse, and participation-based corporate culture that promotes staff wellbeing and sustainable behaviour. Currently we: Participate in the UK government’s Cycle to work scheme to minimise vehicle congestion and greenhouse gas emissions; Regularly fundraise for our charity partners Save the Children and the Aga Khan foundation. We plan to: Partner with Hospitality action to support hospitality employees nationwide; Periodically nominate partner charities with significance to colleagues at GHS.
6. To encourage our suppliers to integrate sustainability in their own operations, and support local business and communities. Currently we: Incorporate locally sourced beverages alongside seasonal produce on our thoughtful in-house menu; We ensure that our food suppliers have strict guidelines to certify that eggs, palm-oil containing products, seafood and meats are sourced sustainably; We support the Felix project, London’s largest food rescue charity, which works with the food industry to rescue surplus food and delivers to over 1,000 community organisations, including 170 schools in London. We plan to: Continue to maintain high ESG standards for our suppliers, with regards to their product sourcing, transport and processing; Organise green teambuilding days within our community to support local sustainability initiatives.
At Grosvenor House Suites, we change your bed linen every other day, and we encourage our guests to reuse their towels, if you require fresh towels daily, please place dirty ones on or in the bathtub and our housekeeping team would delighted to fulfil your requests. These actions are linked with our Sustainability Policy and Green Key accreditation practices, to protect the environment and enable significant savings in energy and water.

Our luxury short-term accommodations offer an excellent city-central location by Hyde Park, our on-site restaurant exclusively open to guests, and a myriad of modern amenities to make your trip to London truly enjoyable.

A suite that functions as a private office and home. High-speed connectivity, in-suite meeting space, and a central Mayfair address for client-facing engagements throughout your London schedule await at Grosvenor House Suites.

Skilled in discreet, anticipatory service, our butlers elevate your stay by attending to laundry, shoe-cleaning, organising meals, or personal shopping. Whether you are recovering post-surgery or enjoying a long weekend in London, this service is available on request at booking.
Please get in touch concierge@grosvenorhousesuites.com

Every suite at Grosvenor House Suites is designed for extended, comfortable living — not simply an overnight stop. Open-plan dining and living areas, fully fitted kitchens, gorgeous Mayfair views, and generous bedrooms mean a short stay feels immediately like home.
Whether you arrive for three nights or three weeks, the same level of service, privacy, and attention to detail applies from the moment you check into our serviced luxury suites and penthouses.
Plan Your Short Stay in Mayfair

Official Medical Stays in Mayfair page:

We offer an unparalleled blend of proximity to world-class healthcare and elite, restorative hospitality in complete privacy. Mayfair serves as the premier residential hub for international patients, post-operative convalescents, and wellness travellers, while our suites and penthouses provide secure, luxury serviced residences equipped with full kitchens for specialised clinical diets, step-free access, and ample space for private nursing staff.
Located close to a number of excellent private hospitals and day clinics as well as Hyde Park, Grosvenor House Suites awaits with a city-central location that still feels like home; perfect for shorter or longer recoveries after a medical procedure.
Convalescent Suites — Recovery in Comfort & Privacy
By combining clinical-grade privacy and hyper-attentive concierge services with immediate access to your luxury accommodation, alongside the therapeutic green spaces of Hyde Park, Grosvenor House Suites provides an exceptionally serene, secure environment optimised for physical rehabilitation and medical recovery.
Our two- and three-bedroom suites offer generous living and sleeping spaces, ideal for patients requiring proximity to a carer or companion. Fully fitted kitchens support clinical dietary requirements, while spacious layouts accommodate private nursing staff during your London medical stay.
Please get in touch concierge@grosvenorhousesuites.com

A highly trained team of expert Clefs d'Or-honoured concierges operate around the clock, coordinating appointments, arranging transport to and from private hospitals, and liaising with medical teams on your behalf so you can solely focus on recovery.

One of London’s First Fractional Ownership Luxury Properties

47 Park Street℠, Grand Residences by Marriott® is one of London’s first fractional ownership properties offering a luxury, intelligent accommodation option in Central London’s Mayfair district for those requiring a flexible alternative to second home ownership.

This magnificent Edwardian-style townhouse was built in 1927 as a private residence for the 1st Baron Milford, and now accommodates Members and guests in 49 impeccably appointed one- and two-bedroom residences.

From the moment you arrive, you’ll enjoy a wealth of modern amenities with a wonderful timeless atmosphere and highly personalised attentive service.

Official Accommodations:

Elegant interiors rich in Edwardian-period detail and original features offer luxury living in each residence. Stylish, comfortable and exquisitely finished, these are residences of rare distinction.

A generous living and dining area with elegant furnishings provides you a sanctuary in which to relax and entertain. Members can leave personal belongings (equivalent to 2 medium suitcases) to be placed in the residence prior to their arrival, enhancing the welcoming atmosphere, with no detail overlooked.

Your living area offers ample space with a dining area accommodating up to six people (in a Two-Bedroom Deluxe Residence). Kitchens are well-equipped with high-end cookware, china, and high-spec appliances. In the master bedroom, the king-sized bed is covered with fine linens, while luxurious marble bathrooms feature period-style fittings.

Official The Location:

47 Park Street, Located in the Heart of Mayfair

47 Park Street is located in the heart of Mayfair, the ideal location to enjoy the quintessential London city lifestyle. One of London’s most fashionable districts, the area has been home to royalty, celebrities, and business tycoons for centuries.

While the bright lights of Marble Arch and Knightsbridge are close by, traditional English charm endures in the Georgian terraces, leafy squares, quiet back streets and hidden mews. Close at hand are the shops and theatres of the West End, the fashion houses of Bond Street, the Cork Street art galleries, and the Mount Street boutiques. There is a rich choice of dining experiences too, with everything from a 300-year-old English inn close by, to Bonheur by Matt Abé, a fine dining restaurant, connected to the property via a private door.

Also at your doorstep are some of London’s finest parks. Amazingly for a city centre, Hyde Park with over 350 acres of green space is home to countless trees, a meadow, horse riding tracks and the famously scenic Serpentine. Green Park, less than half a mile from 47 Park Street, boasts an array of interesting sights and attractions as well.

Official map coordinates published on The Location page: lat 51.511073, lng -0.155017.

Official Membership:

Optimum Flexibility and Convenience

47 Park Street℠, Grand Residences by Marriott® is one of the first luxury properties in London to offer for those looking for a convenient Mayfair pied-à-terre. It’s an opportunity to use a luxurious Mayfair-serviced address at your leisure, and at a fraction of the cost of a full-time residence.

Offering optimum flexibility and convenience, membership gives you the right to use your apartment for a select number of nights each year until 2050. Official FAQ page title: Frequently Asked Questions | AKA Marylebone

Official FAQ — Amenities and services
What makes AKA Marylebone a special place to stay in London?
Located in the heart of Marylebone, AKA Marylebone redefines the modern luxury hotel stay with sophisticated design and thoughtful residential touches. Guests enjoy spacious guestrooms and suites, many with private terraces or city views. The central Marylebone location places guests steps from Hyde Park, Regents Park, London’s West End, and SoHo making AKA Marylebone the ideal choice for week-long getaways, business trips, or cultural escapes.

What makes AKA Marylebone a leading luxury extended-stay hotel in London?
AKA Marylebone is designed for visits of a week, a month, or more, offering the space and privacy of a personal residence with the service of a boutique hotel. Each suite features a separate living area, chef-inspired kitchen with high-end appliances, and all the essentials to work or entertain comfortably. Residents also enjoy access to lifestyle amenities such as complimentary access to Third Space Health Club on Bulstrode Place, bringing the comforts of home to your extended stay.

What are the benefits of booking direct with AKA Marylebone?
Guests who book directly on StayAKA.com enjoy the best available rate, flexible cancellation policies, and exclusive amenities designed with your comfort in mind. Booking direct also ensures a seamless reservation experience with immediate confirmation, and personalized service. It’s the most reliable way to secure the best value and the full range of AKA benefits for your stay.

Where can I find current special offers at AKA Marylebone?
Visit our exclusives page to explore seasonal packages, extended-stay savings, and curated local experiences available at AKA Marylebone in London.

Does AKA Marylebone offer parking?
Parking is not available on property at AKA Marylebone. There is a nearby public car park which is 5-7 minutes walk. Our Mews House features a parking garage, space for parking one car which is exclusive to Mews House residents.

Is public transportation accessible from AKA Marylebone?
There are many public transportation options near AKA Marylebone. We are just 5 minute walk to Bond Street Tube Station which features the Central Line and the Jubliee Line. We are also a 7 minute walk to Marylebone Train Station and Baker Street Tube Station.

Is AKA Marylebone ADA accessible? What accessible features are offered at AKA Marylebone?
We do our best to follow ADA guidelines and ensure our website and property are accessible to all, including those with disabilities. You can find more information on our Accessibility Page.

Are children welcome at AKA Marylebone? What facilities and services are available for children?
Children are always welcome at AKA Marylebone. We are able to arrange babycots, high chairs and any additional item you may need to ensure a comfortable stay.

Can I receive mail and packages at AKA Marylebone?
We gladly accept mail and packages on your behalf. Please speak to the concierge for more information.

Is there Gym Access onsite?
We do not have an onsite gym, however we offer complimentary access to AKA Residents to Third Space Gym Marylebone which is just 2 minutes walk from our property.

Official FAQ — Hotel policies
What time is check-in at AKA Marylebone? Is early check-in possible?
Check-in at AKA Marylebone is from 15:00. Early check-in is possible based on availability.

What time is checkout at AKA Marylebone? Is late checkout possible?
Checkout at AKA Marylebone is before 11:00am. Late checkout is possible based on availability.

Is there an age minimum for check-in?
The minimum age for check-in at AKA Marylebone is 21.

What is AKA Marylebone's cancellation policy?
Our Cancellation policy is dependent on the rate booked and length of stay. For stays of 30 nights or more, we require a 15 days advance notice to amend or cancel a confirmed stay.

Are pets welcome at AKA Marylebone? Is there a fee? What facilities and services are available for pets?
Pets are always welcome at AKA Marylebone. There is a non-refundable fee of £350 per pet.

Peacefully set between the elegant green spaces of Hyde Park and Regents Park, Marylebone is an upscale enclave that offers serene sophistication in the heart of London. Mayfair, Westminster, and The City are all easy to reach from here, as are the renowned shopping, dining, and regal architecture of London’s iconic West End. Explore everything you’ll be able to enjoy while staying with us.

Official neighborhood — Where to Eat in London
Going to London and not having tea is like going to Paris and not seeing the Eiffel Tower. We recommend starting at sketch, located in a beautiful 18th-century building in Mayfair. Afternoon tea is offered in the restaurant’s signature pink dining room, surrounded by framed sketches by David Shrigley. Sample caviar, quail eggs, tea sandwiches, and macaroons as you sip sophisticated blends sourced from around the world. At night, the quirky tea room transforms into a restaurant and cocktail bar helmed by French master chef Pierre Gagnaire.
If you need more recommendations for your foodie tour, we suggest the modern European atmosphere of The Ivy Cafe Marylebone, the Art Deco glamour of The Wolseley, the market-fresh seafood at Scotts Mayfair, and the decadent Austrian elegance of Fischers Marylebone.

Official neighborhood — High Street Shopping in London
The second-largest shop in the United Kingdom (after Harrods), Selfridges is a must-visit on any London shopping spree. Located on Marylebone’s busy Oxford Street, this iconic shopping destination opened in 1909 and is housed in a landmark building. You’ll also find Marylebone High Street just steps from the property, offering boutique shops like Le Labo and lululemon.

Official neighborhood — London Museums and Art Galleries
Located in a historic Marylebone townhouse, the 25 galleries of The Wallace Collection are home to one of Europe’s finest collections of paintings, furniture, arms, and armor. Surpassed only by those in the National Gallery, the paintings by Titian, Rubens, and Rembrandt make The Wallace Collection one of the best in England. Don’t miss the other fantastic London museums nearby, including the world-renowned British Museum in Bloomsbury.

Official neighborhood — Outdoor Activities in London
AKA Marylebone puts you near some of London’s most beautiful outdoor spaces. Take in the picture-perfect townhomes of the West End as you stroll to Regent’s Park or Hyde Park, where you can enjoy a picnic, take a rowboat out on the lake, and escape the bustle of the city. Tree-lined pathways, formal gardens, and London’s largest outdoor sports area are all within walking distance of AKA Marylebone. We also recommend heading up to the top of Primrose Hill for far-reaching views of the city skyline.

Official neighborhood — London Events
London is a city that buzzes with excitement year-round, offering a diverse calendar of events that celebrate culture, sport, fashion, and history. Here are some of the city’s most iconic annual events:
New Year’s Day Parade (January) – A spectacular parade through central London featuring performers, dancers, and musicians from around the world.
London Fashion Week (February & September) – One of the world’s top fashion events, showcasing the latest trends and designers.
The Boat Race (March/April) – A historic rowing competition between Oxford and Cambridge universities on the River Thames.
Chelsea Flower Show (May) – A world-famous floral and garden design exhibition hosted by the Royal Horticultural Society.
Trooping the Colour (June) – A grand military parade celebrating the official birthday of the King, held at Horse Guards Parade.
Wimbledon Championships (June/July) – The world’s oldest and most prestigious tennis tournament, drawing global attention.
Notting Hill Carnival (August) – Europe’s largest street festival, celebrating Caribbean culture with vibrant parades, music, and food.
London Film Festival (October) – A premier international film festival featuring screenings, talks, and special events.
Bonfire Night (November 5th) – Also known as Guy Fawkes Night, marked with fireworks displays across the city.
Winter Wonderland (November–January) – A festive extravaganza in Hyde Park with ice skating, Christmas markets, and rides.
No matter the season, London offers something for everyone. Plan your visit around these must-experience events and immerse yourself in the city's vibrant energy.
