Upmarket Fulham is home to trendy shopping streets like Fulham Road, plenty of restaurants, pubs and bars, and riverside walks, making it a perfect area to stay. With Parsons Green and Putney Bridge underground stations a short walk from our apartments, the attractions of Wimbledon, Earl’s Court, Kensington, and central London can be easily reached via the District line; and corporate travellers can get to the business hubs of Hammersmith and the City with ease. Football fans are in luck too, with Craven Cottage (London’s oldest stadium and home to Fulham FC) and Stamford Bridge stadium (home to Chelsea FC) both less than 20 minutes’ walk away. The riverside Fulham Palace, about 10 minutes’ walk away, displays paintings, archaeology and artefacts tracing the history of the Palace site from prehistoric times, while the 13 acres of botanical gardens are a great place to enjoy a sunny afternoon. While there, stop in at Grade II listed Bishops Park, a lovely relaxing spot on the banks of the Thames, or head to nearby London Wetland Centre to explore a 100-acre nature hotspot.

Shopping
Fulham Road is lined with chic boutiques, home-goods stores, and posh delis; it’s also where you’ll find quirky, super-stacked Hurlingham Books, which has been established since 1968. At the very top of Fulham Road Brompton Cross (about 20 minutes from our apartments via the District line) is an upscale neighbourhood lined with premium fashionwear and lifestyle stores, such as Chanel, Maje and Percy Bass – make sure to admire the decorative art nouveau architecture of Michelin House while you’re there. King’s Road, Chelsea’s famous shopping street, and the vibrant hub of Duke of York Square can be reached in about 30 minutes by public transport, offering even more boutique and designer stores to explore.

Food & Drink
The proximity to bustling Fulham Road means you’re not short of options for places to eat and drink, with a variety of cuisines to sample. Tamini Lebanese Bakery is a compact, cosy neighbourhood spot offering excellent pastries and great weekend brunches if you can snag a table – and if you can’t, simply enjoy your meal back at your apartment! Exposed-brick walls house the trendy (and dog-friendly) spot Boys’n’Berry; it’s a great place to enjoy a morning coffee or grab lunch. Fancy traditional fish and chips? Award-winning Fishers is a brilliant chippie just 7 minutes’ walk from our apartments. Family-run La Pizzica offers a taste of the southern Italian food that its owners grew up with: think handmade pasta, pizza, seafood and grilled dishes. For something special, head to the River Café; a Fulham institution known for its mouthwatering, premium Italian food in a gorgeous riverside setting – it’s where the likes of Jamie Oliver and Hugh Fearnley-Whittingstall trained.

Night Life
Catch live music, comedy and more at nearby Hammersmith’s legendary performance venue the Apollo, which can be reached in around 15 minutes; or kick off the evening with thought-provoking theatre at the Lyric Hammersmith. The Little Blue Door is one of Fulham's best late night cocktail bars and restaurants serving up weekly supper clubs and bottomless brunches; the quirky venue is styled as a flat, offering you entrance to the coolest house party around, with delicious food and drinks to enjoy. Fan of bubbly? Amuse Bouche in Parsons Green is a brick-walled bar with botanical interiors, offering a variety of champagnes, original-recipe cocktails and nibbles on the side. Meanwhile neighbourhood wine bar Vagabond has been serving the Fulham community since 2010; stop in to sample one of the 100+ wines available by bottle or glass, with a side of charcuterie and cheese, in a relaxed environment. If you prefer something more low-key, popular pub the White Horse (10 minutes’ walk) is found in picturesque Parsons Green; beer lovers will enjoy the many varieties on offer, while the expansive garden and Victorian interiors make it a great spot, whatever the weather!

Official property page — neighbourhood and apartment
Welcome to an elegant and private haven in the heart of one of London's most prestigious neighbourhoods.

Boasting luxurious living spaces and unparalleled convenience, these exquisite one- and two-bedroom serviced apartments are set within a beautifully maintained period building. The property is perfectly located mere moments from Bond Street tube station and the famous shopping destination of Oxford Street.

Step into the immaculate interiors, designed to an exceptional standard throughout. Expansive and airy, the apartments feature new herringbone timber flooring, high ceilings and large windows. Open plan living and dining areas combine luxury with supreme comfort. The sizable lounges are furnished with large sofas, coffee tables and smart TVs while the dining areas come perfectly equipped with everything you need. The custom-designed kitchens are complete with high-spec, integrated appliances, including a fridge/freezer, dishwasher, electric hob, oven, washer-dryer, as well as Nespresso coffee machines.

Spacious bedrooms are beautifully finished with carpeted flooring, top-range mattresses, and built-in wardrobes with ample storage. Bathrooms are modern and pristine, featuring stunning herringbone tiling, brushed-brass fittings, and either a bath with shower overhead or a walk-in shower.

Enhanced luxury servicing included
Enhanced services at this property ensure a five-star stay including a range of bespoke service and product options, 24-hour guest services to provide support, a personal safe in every apartment and Wi-Fi included as standard. Our highly experience on-site concierge will meet and greet and provide assistance during your stay (please note this is not 24/7).

Extra occupants
All apartments have a sofa bed in the living room. If you require use of the sofa bed for extra occupants, simply email reservations@viridianapartments.com (stay@viridianapartments.com) after you have booked and our reservations team can accommodate for the extra occupancy (please note that an added charge will apply of approximately 10-15% of the nightly rate per person).

Minimum Stay
Please note that we require a minimum stay of 90 nights for all bookings in Mayfair.

Official property page — Things to do around Mayfair Serviced Apartments - Peterson House

Introduction
Bordering the verdant expanses of Hyde Park and Green Park, with wide streets flanked by elegant Georgian architecture, Mayfair is renowned as one of London’s most upscale neighbourhoods. It’s the perfect location to enjoy the very finest the capital has to offer: from designer shops, trendy boutiques and premium department stores to opulent restaurants and chic bars. There are plenty of galleries and museums in the area where you can take in some culture: Sadie Coles was at the forefront of the Young British Artists movement and still champions emerging artists today, the Royal Academy of Arts counted Constable and Turner among its students and holds regular exhibitions, and the Handel Hendrix House celebrates musical legends George Frideric Handel and Jimi Hendrix who both lived here. Just a few moments from our apartments, Grosvenor Square and Brown Hart Gardens both provide a tranquil oasis in the heart of this vibrant part of London.

Shopping
Mayfair is famous for being one of the world's best luxury shopping destinations - not to mention the nearby shopping meccas that are Oxford Street, Regent's Street and Carnaby Street. Head to Savile Row for bespoke men’s tailoring or Mount Street where you’ll find designer super-brands such as Jenny Packham, Oscar de la Renta, Lanvin, Balmain and Erdem. Burlington Arcade, built in 1818, is home to jewellery boutiques, celebrated perfume houses, luxury fashion and Ladurée, a treasure trove of macarons, bonbons and loose-leaf tea. For interesting boutiques, visit pedestrianised South Molton Street, just off Oxford Street. Here you can browse jewellery at Monica Vinader, womenswear at Claudie Pierlot and ME+EM, or premium beauty at Space NK. Bibliophiles should make a stop at Heywood Hill, a literary landmark selling new, old and rare books. English novelist Nancy Mitford worked here during the 1940s, helping establish this magical little bookshop as a centre of English social and literary life.

Food & Drink
Mayfair is home to London’s finest restaurants, with an expansive gastronomic scene to explore. Just three minutes from our serviced apartments, Popina is an upmarket all-day eatery with excellent coffee, pastries and a popular brunch menu. For lunch, try Apricity; with a sustainable, zero-waste approach to cooking, this restaurant champions seasonal British produce. North Audley Street is Mayfair’s culinary hotspot; here you’ll find Mercato Mayfair (six minutes’ walk from our apartments), featuring a grocery shop with sustainably sourced and artisan products, three levels of food and drinks stalls, and a roof terrace all housed in the stunning regenerated sanctuary of St Mark’s. Looking to refuel after a spot of shopping on Mount Street? Enjoy a coffee and sandwich at hip café Hideaway; try something sweet at the London outpost of Milanese pastry shop Marchesi; or head to traditional neighbourhood pub The Audley. For something really special, 28-50 in nearby Oxford Circus combines chic interiors with excellent wine and modern European food.

Night Life
The vibrant theatrical delights of London’s West End are easily reached from our Mayfair apartments, either via the Elizabeth Line from Bond Street or by foot in around 20 minutes. Here you can enjoy world-class musicals, plays, cabaret, comedy and more. If you’re looking for a quintessentially British pub in which to while away the evening, there are plenty to choose from: you’ll be spoiled for choice at The Market Tavern’s large bar, while The Punchbowl’s Grade II listed Georgian building offers gorgeous, homely surrounds. And The Running Horse, just a couple of minutes from our apartments, is Mayfair’s oldest pub, having been founded in 1738. It celebrates all things British – from the quirky décor to the seasonal menu of food and drink. For cocktails, head to elegantly eccentric bar Mr Fogg’s Apothecary on Brook Street (three minutes from our serviced apartments) or visit iconic Manetta’s Bar, a luxurious, 1930s-style locale offering inventive twists on your favourite drinks. In nearby Maryebone, 28-50 by Night is a fantastic jazz bar with excellent wine and nibbles.

Official property page — neighbourhood and apartment
Welcome to an elegant and private haven in the heart of one of London's most prestigious neighbourhoods.

Boasting luxurious living spaces and unparalleled convenience, these exquisite one- and two-bedroom serviced apartments are set within a beautifully maintained period building. The property is perfectly located mere moments from Bond Street tube station and the famous shopping destination of Oxford Street.

Step into the immaculate interiors, designed to an exceptional standard throughout. Open plan living and dining areas combine luxury with supreme comfort. The sizable lounges are furnished with large sofas, coffee tables and smart TVs while the dining areas come perfectly equipped with everything you need. The custom-designed kitchens are complete with high-spec, integrated appliances, including a fridge/freezer, dishwasher, electric hob, oven, washer-dryer, as well as Nespresso coffee machines.

Spacious bedrooms are beautifully finished with carpeted flooring, top-range mattresses, and built-in wardrobes with ample storage. Bathrooms are modern and pristine, featuring stunning herringbone tiling, brushed-brass fittings, and either a bath with shower overhead or a walk-in shower.

Enhanced luxury servicing included
Enhanced services at this property ensure a five-star stay including an on-site concierge offering a range of bespoke service and product options, 24-hour guest services to provide support, a personal safe in every apartment and Wi-Fi included as standard.

Extra occupants
All apartments have a sofa bed in the living room. If you require use of the sofa bed for extra occupants, simply email reservations@viridianapartments.com after you have booked and our reservations team can accommodate for the extra occupancy (please note that an added charge will apply of approximately 10-15% of the nightly rate per person).

*Please note that the images depicting the standalone bath and large separate dining area are features of the two-bed duplex apartment in this building.

Minimum Stay
Please note that we require a minimum stay of 90 nights for all bookings in Mayfair.

Parking
We do not have our own private parking available in this location but here is a link to a parking company called JustPark who has a network of spaces consisting of commercial properties, residential driveways and everything in between. This link will show our apartment location and nearby parking spaces which you can book via JustPark.

Parking options near to Darley House
JustPark is an award-winning company and we are happy to put you in touch with them but please note that any parking bookings you make are solely with JustPark. Viridian Apartments is not a party to the parking contract and holds no responsibility or liability in relation to the parking booking which is separate to any apartment booking. Any questions about a parking booking are via the JustPark channels.

Official property page — Things to do around Mayfair Serviced Apartments - Darley House

Introduction
Bordering the verdant expanses of Hyde Park and Green Park, with wide streets flanked by elegant Georgian architecture, Mayfair is renowned as one of London’s most upscale neighbourhoods. It’s the perfect location to enjoy the very finest the capital has to offer: from designer shops, trendy boutiques and premium department stores to opulent restaurants and chic bars. There are plenty of galleries and museums in the area where you can take in some culture: Sadie Coles was at the forefront of the Young British Artists movement and still champions emerging artists today, the Royal Academy of Arts counted Constable and Turner among its students and holds regular exhibitions, and the Handel Hendrix House celebrates musical legends George Frideric Handel and Jimi Hendrix who both lived here. Just a few moments from our apartments, Grosvenor Square and Brown Hart Gardens both provide a tranquil oasis in the heart of this vibrant part of London.

Shopping
Mayfair is famous for being one of the world's best luxury shopping destinations - not to mention the nearby shopping meccas that are Oxford Street, Regent's Street and Carnaby Street. Head to Savile Row for bespoke men’s tailoring or Mount Street where you’ll find designer super-brands such as Jenny Packham, Oscar de la Renta, Lanvin, Balmain and Erdem. Burlington Arcade, built in 1818, is home to jewellery boutiques, celebrated perfume houses, luxury fashion and Ladurée, a treasure trove of macarons, bonbons and loose-leaf tea. For interesting boutiques, visit pedestrianised South Molton Street, just off Oxford Street. Here you can browse jewellery at Monica Vinader, womenswear at Claudie Pierlot and ME+EM, or premium beauty at Space NK. Bibliophiles should make a stop at Heywood Hill, a literary landmark selling new, old and rare books. English novelist Nancy Mitford worked here during the 1940s, helping establish this magical little bookshop as a centre of English social and literary life.

Food & Drink
Mayfair is home to London’s finest restaurants, with an expansive gastronomic scene to explore. Just three minutes from our serviced apartments, Popina is an upmarket all-day eatery with excellent coffee, pastries and a popular brunch menu. For lunch, try Apricity; with a sustainable, zero-waste approach to cooking, this restaurant champions seasonal British produce. North Audley Street is Mayfair’s culinary hotspot; here you’ll find Mercato Mayfair (six minutes’ walk from our apartments), featuring a grocery shop with sustainably sourced and artisan products, three levels of food and drinks stalls, and a roof terrace all housed in the stunning regenerated sanctuary of St Mark’s. Looking to refuel after a spot of shopping on Mount Street? Enjoy a coffee and sandwich at hip café Hideaway; try something sweet at the London outpost of Milanese pastry shop Marchesi; or head to traditional neighbourhood pub The Audley. For something really special, 28-50 in nearby Oxford Circus combines chic interiors with excellent wine and modern European food.

Night Life
The vibrant theatrical delights of London’s West End are easily reached from our Mayfair apartments, either via the Elizabeth Line from Bond Street or by foot in around 20 minutes. Here you can enjoy world-class musicals, plays, cabaret, comedy and more. If you’re looking for a quintessentially British pub in which to while away the evening, there are plenty to choose from: you’ll be spoiled for choice at The Market Tavern’s large bar, while The Punchbowl’s Grade II listed Georgian building offers gorgeous, homely surrounds. And The Running Horse, just a couple of minutes from our apartments, is Mayfair’s oldest pub, having been founded in 1738. It celebrates all things British – from the quirky décor to the seasonal menu of food and drink. For cocktails, head to elegantly eccentric bar Mr Fogg’s Apothecary on Brook Street (three minutes from our serviced apartments) or visit iconic Manetta’s Bar, a luxurious, 1930s-style locale offering inventive twists on your favourite drinks. In nearby Maryebone, 28-50 by Night is a fantastic jazz bar with excellent wine and nibbles.

Official property page — neighbourhood and apartment
Enjoy a premium, and centrally located, stay with our charming collection of one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, including some duplex apartments, on prestigious Chancery Lane. The proximity to the City, Covent Garden, Leicester Square, and the West End theatre district makes these apartments the perfect base for both corporate and leisure travellers.

Viridian Apartments Chancery Lane is set over five floors within a Grade II listed building, originally a pair of nineteenth-century townhouses. Featuring high ceilings, bespoke double-glazed casement windows and contemporary light oak wood floors, these apartments offer natural light and space. The building’s historic features are complemented with elegant finishes throughout.

Stylish open plan living and dining areas come with comfortable furniture, and the bespoke kitchens are fully equipped with a fridge/freezer, dishwasher, washer/dryer, oven with hob and granite worktops. Bathrooms are contemporary, featuring Italian porcelain tiling. In the bedrooms, deep-pile carpets bring an additional touch of luxury, with ample space for storage included and top-range mattresses to ensure a great night’s rest. Select apartments have the added benefit of private outside space (roof terrace, terrace, or balcony). Complimentary Wi-Fi is included for all stays. The building includes a lift (although some steps are required to access all floors) and internal cycle storage.

Chancery Lane underground station is an 8-minute walk from our apartments, for onward travel via the Central line. City Thameslink station is a 10-minute walk away, for trains to King’s Cross, serving northern regional stations and Scotland, and St Pancras International for Eurostar services to continental Europe. London City airport can be reached in around 40 minutes via public transport.

Official property page — Things to do around Chancery Lane Serviced Apartments

Introduction
Chancery Lane runs through the heart of London’s historic and current legal district, home to The Law Society’s headquarters as well as other major corporations and businesses. This makes it perfectly placed for business trips, yet with Covent Garden, Leicester Square and the West End nearby, this location is also a great choice for leisure travellers looking to stay central in London. There are plenty of attractions and notable landmarks within easy walking distance. Sir John Soane's Museum(9 min walk) houses a free-to-visit collection of antiquities, furniture, and artworks, located next to the capital’s largest public square, Lincoln’s Inn Fields – a great spot to enjoy a coffee on a sunny day. St Paul’s Cathedral(14 min walk) is an architectural icon, while a number of West End theatres are around 12 minutes’ walk, including the Lyceum, Novello Theatre, and Theatre Royal Drury Lane. It’s a short walk to the Thames Riverfront from our apartments; here you can walk towards Temple, where you’ll find art and culture at the Courthauld Gallery and Somerset House, or cross Blackfriars Bridge to discover the Tate Modern, Shakespeare’s Globe and the vibrant South Bank.

Shopping
Our Chancery Lane apartments are well-placed for visiting some of London’s most iconic markets. Shop for a unique souvenir at Covent Garden’s Apple Market, home to artisan stalls selling goods and crafts, as well as boutique stores. In the same complex, the East Colonnade Market is filled with jewellery stalls, sweet treats and handmade soaps, while the Jubilee Market offers an excellent selection of antiques and collectibles. Nearby Neal’s Yard is a colourful alley and courtyard packed with independent shops and places for al-fresco dining; head to the eponymous Neal’s Yard Remedies for natural skincare. Historic Leather Lane Market (11 min walk) is a brilliant spot for foodies with a huge variety of street food, as well as traditional stalls selling fashion, goods and flowers. Then head to nearby Hatton Garden’s famous diamond boutiques to enjoy some jewellery shopping. Or for a (literal) hidden gem, the London Silver Vaults is a unique underground marketplace for luxury silver shopping, just five minutes from our apartments.

Food & Drink
Within a short walk of our apartments, you’ll find coffee shops, delis, gastropubs, and upmarket restaurants where you can enjoy a range of cuisines. Start the day off with Press Coffee & Co; with ingredients sourced seasonally, both of its locations (on Chancery Lane and Fleet Street) are great spots for a morning beverage. For lunch, brave the queues at popular local institution Dilieto, a tucked-away deli on Fleet Street which has been selling sandwiches for over a hundred years – get there early and enjoy the incredible selection of mouthwatering doorstop sandwiches. For authentic Vietnamese, try Banh Mi Bay in nearby Holborn, which has plenty of meat-free options too. Alternatively you might like to stop in at one of the many pubs in the area: The Old Bank of England has stunning interiors and honest pub grub, with the pies being particularly popular, while The Last Judgment serves up a ‘Steak and Sole’ menu. For dinner, head to Goucho for Argentinian steak, Brasserie Blanc for classic French dishes, Ave Mario for Italian staples in a cheerful and bright space, or Barrafina Drury Lane for Spanish small plates in cosy surrounds.

Night Life
Start your evening with a show and head towards Strand to reach the West End theatres – The Aldwych Theatre, the Gillian Lynne Theatre, the Novello, the Theatre Royal Drury Lane, the Lyceum…take your pick of the evening performances! Alternatively, walk 14 minutes to The Garden Cinema, an independent joint screening new releases and indie flicks in funky art deco interiors, or catch a performance of world-class opera or ballet at the Royal Opera House. Afterwards, head back towards your serviced apartment where you can enjoy a nightcap at the quirky basement bar Baranis; with specialist herb-infused cocktails, absinthe and the UK’s only indoor pétanque court, you have all the ingredients for a unique evening. On Fleet Street, popular and long-established wine bar El Vino used to be a meeting place for journalists and is now a great spot to enjoy a diverse wine list and small plates.

Official property page — neighbourhood and apartment
Housed in a converted former church on the banks of the River Thames, these two- and three-bedroom luxury serviced apartments offer an exquisite stay, whether you are in Brentford for business or leisure. Enjoy stunning views, the convenience of a vibrant high street right on your doorstep, West London’s best attractions in easy reach and excellent transport connectivity – with Kew Bridge station just 0.4 miles away and Brentford Station 0.9 miles away, getting around London is easy. Heathrow Airport is reachable in a 20-minute drive.

This historic building has been renovated with the architectural integrity it deserves, preserving the original characterful details while modernising the interiors to make for a truly unique stay. The apartments are airy and expansive, with beautifully-appointed interiors designed with your comfort in mind, and contemporary fixtures and fittings throughout. Large windows allow for plenty of natural light while also offering fantastic views of the surrounding area.

Open plan layouts provide you with plenty of space in which to work, cook and relax. Kitchens are fully equipped with high-spec integrated appliances, including an oven and hob, washer/dryer, and fridge/freezer. The modern bathrooms come with rain shower heads and the spacious bedrooms contain high-quality beds and plenty of storage.

The building benefits from a lift, as well as outdoor space: the ground floor apartments have private gardens, while some apartments on other levels come with balconies and the top-floor apartments have access to roof terraces. There is also a bike store on site.

This is a great option for those travelling with sustainability in mind. The building is highly insulated, with high performance double-glazed aluminium windows and external doors. Heating and water are powered by an energy-efficient external heat pump and low-energy light fittings are used throughout.

Parking can be booked, subject to availability (please book with our reservations team: stay@viridianapartments.com).

Official property page — Things to do around Kew Bridge  Serviced Apartments - St Georges

Introduction
With a riverfront view, Kew Gardens across the water and the busy high streets of Chiswick and Richmond in easy reach, these apartments are well-located for corporate and leisure travellers alike. The key business hub of Brentside Park is a 6-minute drive away, while nearby Kew Bridge station and Brentford station both offer excellent transport links into the city. In the immediate area, the famous Kew Gardens -and hidden royal home Kew Palace - are just a short walk across the bridge. Overlooking the gardens is Watermans Art Centre, with a 239-seat theatre, a 125-seat cinema and two galleries to enjoy. The Musical Museum, a few minutes up the high street, displays a wonderful collection of automated musical instruments and hosts live concerts. The London Museum of Water and Steam is something of a local gem - this historic pumping station provides plenty of hands-on family fun if you’re travelling with young ones. On sunny days, walk along the Thames Path and admire the colourful houseboats, or head to nearby Syon Park to explore its 40 acres of gardens and historic house filled with incredible art.

Shopping
The multitude of independent retailers and brand-name shops on Chiswick High Street can be found just a short 10-minute bus ride from our apartments. Across the bridge in nearby Kew, there is a retail park with high-street brands, while on the first Sunday of the month, Kew Village Market hosts up to 45 independent traders selling everything from artisan food to handmade crafts and unique gifts – it’s a real community hub, with live music and charity stalls helping to raise funds for local initiatives. While on that side of the river, bookworms looking for their next read should head to Lloyds of Kew, which has been an independent bookseller for over 40 years and offers a selection of contemporary and rare second-hand books. For premium designers and big-name brands, Westfield in Shepherd’s Bush can be reached in 35 minutes by bus. Here you’ll find hundreds of beauty, household, fashion, jewellery and accessories stores, as well as restaurants, cafés and bars in which to take a breather.

Food & Drink
Great places to eat and drink can be found in easy walking distance. The Roastery, housed in the train station building by Kew Bridge (8 minutes’ walk), is a great spot for locally-roasted coffee. If you’re visiting Kew Gardens, book a visit to The Original Maids of Honour, a tea room keeping traditional baking skills alive for over 150 years – try their eponymous melt-in-the-mouth pastries. For dinner, head down the high street to Galata Para, a warmly-lit restaurant serving Turkish and Mediterranean cuisine; while La Rosetta is the place to go for traditional Italian small plates, pastas, and mains in a rustic setting with outdoor tables. Upmarket seafood restaurant Makai has three boldly-decorated floors in which to enjoy fare inspired by Southern US food, like crab boils, as well as sushi. If you’d like to enjoy a riverside pint or a cosy pub meal, try One Over The Ait near Kew Bridge, or head over the bridge to The Cricketers which has a large beer garden and a menu of British classics. The Black Dog Beer House and The Brook are also popular options for relaxed drinks and eclectic menus in the heart of Brentford.

Night Life
Visit the Watermans Art Centre to catch an evening film, whether you like family flicks, blockbusters or arthouse and international movies. For relaxed drinks and live music in Brentford, try local pub The Globe or head to nearby Kew Green to enjoy a tipple at refurbished historic pub The Botanist. Clustered around historic Brentford Docks on the banks of the River Brent (about 14 minutes’ walk from our apartments) there are some great pubs and bars in which to while away an evening. You’ll find amazing cocktails at Aqua Vista Bistro Bar – and any budding vocalists might like to hit the mic during the regular karaoke night! Award-winning riverside venue The Weir Bar has been serving the Brentford community for 20 years, and is a great place to unwind with a cocktail or enjoy live music and DJ sets on the weekend. Meanwhile at Plonkers Wine Bar you’re guaranteed a unique evening; funky music, fine wine, retro interior design, and classic, vintage and supercars all come together under one roof to create quite the hidden gem, whether you want to relax, dance or sample some excellent vintages.

Nestled perfectly between the City and Canary Wharf, Commercial Road serviced apartments offer an unbeatable location. This vibrant and dynamic part of London provides an excellent central base with an abundance of places to eat, drink, shop, and soak up some culture just moments away.

Official property page — Prime Central Location
Situated in one of London’s most sought-after areas, this newly-built apartment block comprises 38 units spread across five floors. A range of accommodation is offered, including studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments.

This location boasts exceptional transport connectivity with three major stations within easy walking distance:

· Shadwell Overground and DLR: 8-minute walk
· Whitechapel Underground and Overground: 10-minute walk
· Aldgate East Underground: 12-minute walk

Official property page — Comfortable apartments
Each apartment is designed with comfort and convenience in mind, featuring open-plan layouts and neutral, calming palettes. Décor, furniture and furnishings have been meticulously crafted by expert interior designers, ensuring an exemplary fit-out.
Fully-equipped kitchens come with everything you need to prepare delicious meals, with an oven with hob, fridge-freezer, utensils and practical appliances such as dishwashers and washer-dryers. Enjoy your culinary creations at the elegant dining tables, designed to provide a comfortable and inviting dining experience.
Bedrooms are designed for ultimate comfort and relaxation, featuring king-size beds with high-quality mattresses. There is ample storage space for belongings to be kept organised and easily accessible.
All one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments are equipped with high-quality sofa beds in the living rooms and select studio apartments include this feature as well. To accommodate extra guests and ensure additional bedding, please contact our reservations team when booking.
Living areas are also furnished with additional seating in the larger apartments, a coffee table and Smart TV (personal accounts required to access streaming content on the TV apps).
Bathrooms offer contemporary tiling and modern fixtures. Walk in showers (no bath) feature in every apartment.
Apartments on the 5th floor also include private outside balconies with breathtaking views.

· Air-conditioning for comfort all year-round
· Free Wi-Fi to stay connected
· Lift access for ultimate convenience

Acoustic glazing enhances insulation, minimising noise pollution and improving energy efficiency.
A 21kW solar panel system not only powers the building’s heating and ventilation but also feeds excess energy back into the grid.

Official property page — Things to do around Commercial Road Serviced Apartments - London City East

Introduction
Exploring the area around Commercial Road in London offers a diverse range of activities and attractions that cater to various interests. Just a short walk away, you’ll find yourself in the heart of the vibrant East End, where cultural richness and historical significance converge.
For art enthusiasts, the Whitechapel Gallery is a must-visit. Located nearby, this contemporary art gallery hosts rotating exhibitions featuring both established and emerging artists. It’s a great place to immerse yourself in the local art scene, with various events and talks that often accompany the exhibitions.
If you’re interested in history, take a leisurely stroll to The Tower of London, just a short walk away. This UNESCO World Heritage Site is steeped in history, offering guided tours that delve into its fascinating past as a royal palace, prison, and treasury. Be sure to catch a glimpse of the Crown Jewels, an awe-inspiring collection that showcases the grandeur of British royalty.
Nature lovers can enjoy a walk through Shadwell Basin, a tranquil spot that offers scenic views and a peaceful escape from the urban hustle. The area is perfect for a leisurely stroll or a picnic by the water, providing a moment of serenity amidst the vibrant city life.

Shopping
Brick Lane is renowned for its bustling market and array of vintage shops. This iconic street is a haven for food lovers, offering everything from traditional bagels to mouthwatering Indian cuisine. The atmosphere is electric, especially on Sundays when the market comes alive with street performers and artisans showcasing their crafts.
A visit to the trendy Spitalfields Market is always a treat. This historic market is a blend of boutique shops, artisanal food stalls, and vibrant restaurants, making it an ideal place to unwind and experience the local culture. Whether you're looking to shop for unique gifts or indulge in delicious street food, Spitalfields offers a lively atmosphere that captures the essence of East London.

Food & Drink
Staying near Commercial Road in London puts you within easy reach of some fantastic food and drink options. Just a short walk away, Tayyabs is a local favourite for Punjabi cuisine, known for its sizzling lamb chops.
If you're looking for a top coffee, Etre is at 171 Commercial Road a couple of minutes away, and offers speciality coffee and premium baked goods.
If you're in the mood for drinks, The George Tavern is a legendary venue, public house and constant foundation for a thriving artistic community in the heart of London's east end.

Night Life
For cocktails in a cosy setting, Apples & Pears near Brick Lane is a hidden gem, serving creative drinks with a laid-back vibe.
Troxy, located at 490 Commercial Road, is a stunning Grade II-listed Art Deco venue that first opened in 1933 as a cinema. Over the years, it has evolved into a versatile events space hosting concerts, club nights, and cultural events. With its grand interiors and restored Wurlitzer organ, Troxy blends historic charm with a lively modern atmosphere, making it a standout destination in East London's nightlife scene.

World-class accommodation, in the heart of London.

Knightsbridge apartments offer a unique blend of luxury and convenience, making them ideal for a variety of stays. For family holidays, the spacious apartments provide a comfortable and secure environment, with easy access to family-friendly attractions like Hyde Park and world-class museums. Our prime location places guests in the heart of London, with exclusive shopping, fine dining, and cultural landmarks just moments away. For those requiring medical stays, Knightsbridge is ideally situated near some of the city’s top private hospitals and clinics, ensuring quick access to world-class healthcare. Situated in the heart of the city, it provides easy access to iconic landmarks such as Hyde Park, Harrods, and the Victoria and Albert Museum, while also being well-connected to the rest of London via public transport. ## Local Area Guide

A guide to Knightsbridge and the surrounding area, from the people who know it best.

Knightsbridge, one of London’s most prestigious neighbourhoods, is renowned for its world-class shopping, exquisite dining, and rich cultural history, offering an unrivalled blend of luxury and charm at every turn. Our local area guide showcases the very best of Knightsbridge, from iconic landmarks to hidden gems waiting to be discovered. Below, you’ll find our carefully curated highlights of all the finest experiences Knightsbridge has to offer.

Eating out — The finest eateries in London. London is a global culinary capital, and Knightsbridge is at its heart, boasting some of the finest eateries in the city. From Michelin-starred dining experiences to charming bistros and stylish cafes, the area offers a rich variety of cuisines to suit every palate. Indulge in gourmet creations from acclaimed chefs at renowned establishments such as Petrus by Gordon Ramsay or Dinner by Heston Blumenthal, or savour an elegant afternoon tea at one of the area’s luxury hotels. With its perfect blend of sophistication and flavour, Knightsbridge sets the standard for culinary excellence in London.

The Grenadier Pub, Belgravia. The Grenadier in Belgrave Square is royalty amongst London pubs. This historic treasure chest is a hidden gem, beloved by both locals and visitors. Our Apartments page also publishes: The Grenadier Pub on Wilton Row, steeped in history and charm, is renowned for its cozy atmosphere and high quality traditional British pub food.

Pétrus by Gordon Ramsey, Belgravia. Pétrus by Gordon Ramsay offers an exceptional Michelin-starred dining experience, renowned for its modern French cuisine, impeccable service, and elegant setting in the heart of Belgravia.

Dinner by Heston, Knightsbridge. Dinner by Heston Blumenthal is a two-Michelin-starred restaurant celebrated for its innovative reinterpretation of historic British dishes, in a sophisticated and contemporary dining space.

Zuma, Knightsbridge. This long-standing Knightsbridge restaurant is the original of the now world-famous group. We love its informal, izakaya-inspired Japanese cuisine.

The Chinoiserie at Jumeirah, Knightsbridge. The Chinoiserie restaurant offers a harmonious blend of elegant Asian-inspired décor and exquisite cuisine, creating a dining experience that is both sophisticated and unforgettable.

Amya, Belgravia. This contemporary Indian restaurant offers a dynamic dining experience centered around shareable dishes served fresh from the tawa, tandoor, and sigri grills. We love its vibrant atmosphere.

Shopping — The home of the worlds most iconic shops and brands. Knightsbridge is a shopper’s paradise, offering an unparalleled blend of luxury and elegance. From the world-famous Harrods, a haven of opulence and indulgence, to the iconic Harvey Nichols, known for its cutting-edge fashion and beauty offerings, the area is synonymous with high-end retail. Nestled among its charming streets, you’ll also find an array of exclusive designer boutiques, independent shops, and flagship stores, making it the ultimate destination for those seeking a truly exceptional shopping experience.

Harrods, Knightsbridge. An unparalleled shopping experience with its vast selection of high-end fashion, gourmet food, and exclusive designer brands, right on your doorstep.

Harvey Nichols, Knightsbridge. Celebrated for its curated selection of designer fashion, beauty, and luxury concessions, Harvey Nichols provides a chic shopping experience in the heart of Knightsbridge.

Sloane Street, Knightsbridge. Lined with high-end boutiques and designer stores, offering a refined and elegant shopping experience as you wonder down from Knightsbridge into Chelsea. Our Apartments page: Shopping on Sloane Street epitomises London’s luxury, offering an array of high-end boutiques and flagship stores from world-renowned designer brands.

Fortnum & Mason, Piccadilly. Fortnum & Mason is a prestigious London institution, renowned for its luxurious selection of fine foods, exquisite teas, and elegant gifts, offering a quintessentially British shopping experience.

Selfridges, Oxford Street. This iconic London department store is a short trip away by car, renowned for its innovative fashion, beauty, and lifestyle offerings, blending cutting-edge trends with a vibrant and luxurious setting - it’s certainly worth a visit.

Liberty London, Regent Street. A short drive away is one of Londons most iconic stores. Across six beautifully designed floors, explore a curated collection of fashion, beauty, homeware, and timeless fabrics, offering a true taste of British elegance and craftsmanship.

Things to see, history & culture — Take in London’s rich history. Knightsbridge is steeped in history and culture, offering iconic landmarks like the Brompton Oratory and the Victoria and Albert Museum, home to world-class art and design collections. Nearby, Hyde Park provides a serene escape with its gardens and historic monuments, including the Albert Memorial. Blending rich heritage with vibrant modernity, Knightsbridge is a must-visit for history and culture enthusiasts.

Afternoon Tea at the Ritz, Green Park. Afternoon tea at The Ritz is a quintessentially British experience, offering a timeless blend of elegance, tradition, and indulgence.

Hyde Park, Knightsbridge. Hyde Park is a sprawling and iconic green space in the heart of London, offering serene landscapes, historic landmarks, and a wide range of outdoor activities for both relaxation and recreation.

Royal Albert Hall, Knightsbridge. A historic and iconic concert venue in London, known for its stunning architecture and world-class acoustics, hosting a wide range of events including classical concerts, rock performances, and cultural celebrations.

Natural History Museum, South Kensington. The Natural History Museum in London is a world-renowned institution, home to a vast collection of specimens ranging from dinosaur fossils to rare minerals, offering visitors an engaging and educational experience that highlights the wonders of the natural world.

Buckingham Palace, Westminster. The official residence of the King of England, renowned for its stunning architecture, beautiful gardens, and iconic Changing of the Guard ceremony, offering a glimpse into the history and traditions of the British monarchy.

The V&A, South Kensington. A world-class museum dedicated to art, design, and fashion, housing an extensive collection of over 2.3 million objects that span 5,000 years of history, making it one of the most influential cultural institutions in the world.

Your luxury London getaway — only steps from Harrods. Knightsbridge is London’s premier luxury shopping destination, home to iconic department stores, designer boutiques, and world-renowned brands. With its upscale atmosphere and unparalleled retail offerings, it’s a haven for those seeking the finest in fashion, jewellery, and bespoke goods. From the grandeur of Harrods to the exclusive stores lining Sloane Street, Knightsbridge offers an elite shopping experience that caters to every discerning taste.
